lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with Newark businesses on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Newark is New Jersey's largest city and one of the main transport hubs of the north-east, with a major airport, a container port, a busy rail station and a downtown of corporate offices and universities. We plan marketing for the buyers you have, from a freight manager choosing a carrier to a family in the North Ward choosing a dentist.

sections.heading: A port, an airport and a rail hub
paragraphs: Newark Liberty International Airport and the Port Newark container terminals sit side by side on the city's eastern edge, linked to the Turnpike and the rail network. Around them is a dense cluster of freight forwarders, customs brokers, trucking firms, warehouses and airport services. These companies sell to shippers and importers who compare providers carefully and want to see routes, equipment, certifications and response times before they pick up the phone.

For this trade, a website is a working sales document. We set out services and coverage clearly, build search visibility for specific needs such as drayage or bonded storage, and run campaigns aimed at logistics and procurement roles.

sections.heading: Downtown, the Ironbound and the wards
paragraphs: Downtown holds insurance and financial offices, law firms, the performing arts centre and the arena, which fills nearby streets on hockey and concert nights. Newark Penn Station puts Manhattan a short train ride away, so many office workers and residents live with one foot in each city.

East of the station, the Ironbound is one of the best-known dining districts in the state. Ferry Street and the blocks around it are crowded with restaurants, bakeries and shops, and people travel in from the suburbs to eat there. University Heights is home to Rutgers University-Newark, the New Jersey Institute of Technology and a major teaching hospital, which bring students, staff and patients into the city every day.

Beyond the centre, the North, South, West, Central and East wards are residential neighbourhoods with their own shopping streets. Forest Hill and the area around Branch Brook Park, famous for its cherry blossom in spring, differ a good deal from Weequahic or Vailsburg.
bullets: Pages and listings that name the ward or neighbourhood you serve.
Ad schedules for restaurants built around event nights and weekends.
Targeting that includes nearby towns such as Harrison, Kearny, Belleville, Bloomfield, East Orange and Irvington.
Student and staff offers timed to the university calendar.
Tracking of calls, bookings and forms by channel.

sections.heading: Standing out next to New York
paragraphs: Newark businesses share a media market with New York City, and broad advertising there is costly and wasteful. Tight geographic targeting keeps the spend on people who live, work or travel through Newark and Essex County.

It also helps to be specific in search. A firm that tries to rank for a service across the whole New York area competes with thousands of others. A firm that answers a precise need in Newark, with reviews from local customers and an accurate business profile, has a realistic chance of appearing first.

faqs.q: Can digital marketing bring in leads for a freight or logistics company?
faqs.a: Yes. Shippers and importers search for providers by service and location before making contact. A site with clear technical detail, plus search and LinkedIn campaigns aimed at the right roles, brings in relevant enquiries. Buying decisions in this trade take time.

faqs.q: How can an Ironbound restaurant get more customers?
faqs.a: Keep the Google Business Profile complete with menu, hours and fresh photos, ask diners for reviews, post short video of the food and room, and run local ads on event nights and weekends when people are deciding where to eat.

faqs.q: How do I avoid paying for clicks from all over New York?
faqs.a: Limit ad targeting to Newark and the towns you serve, exclude areas you do not cover, and write ads that name the location. We review the search terms and locations regularly and cut what does not convert.

faqs.q: How much do you charge for marketing in Newark?
faqs.a: Pricing depends on the scope of the work. We hold a free consultation first and then send a quote.
